name: GitNexus
title_zh: 把任意代码仓库变成可对话的知识图谱
tagline_zh: 丢进 GitHub/GitLab 或本地 ZIP，浏览器里生成交互式图谱，内置 Graph RAG Agent 直。
tagline_en: Drop any repo or ZIP into your browser, get an interactive knowledge graph with a built-in Graph RAG agent to.
desc_en: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine -       GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph creator that runs entirely in your browser. Drop in a git repository (Github, Gitlab, Azure, Local) or ZIP file, and get an interactive knowledge graph with a built in Graph RAG Agent. Perfect for code exploration
why_zh: 图谱节点是真实代码实体，边是调用/继承关系，RAG 检索基于图结构而非纯文本，问『谁调用了这个函数』能。
why_en: Graph nodes map to real code symbols, edges to call/inheritance links. RAG walks the graph, not raw text, so 'who calls this.
limit_zh: 只支持代码仓库，不含文档/配置文件语义；超大仓库（>500MB）首次建图会卡；图谱不导出，关标签页即丢。
limit_en: Code repos only—no docs/config semantics. >500MB repos stall on first build. Graph isn't exportable; closing the tab loses it. Needs modern browser.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
